{{Top|fa|leg}}
{{Quote|Such easy access to currency may be perilous, says economist Argee Beck.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|business/13314_1.html|Currency Upheavals Deliver Profits to IBC}}</ref>}}
[[File:KaneGriggs-DE3.png|thumb|right|300px|New Republic Defense Fleet navigator Kane Griggs originally wanted to become an economist.]]
An '''economist''' was a specialist in the field of [[Economics/Legends|economics]], with a [[system economist]] being a type of economist. Members of the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who possessed complex binary [[Brain/Legends|brains]] facilitating rapid processing of information as well as a good ability to notice patterns and trends, became renowned as expert economists not long after making first contact with the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. After [[Second Battle of Coruscant|warfare]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] caused incalculable damage and population casualties on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], economists made dire predictions about how much [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-world]] would need to recover&mdash;prognoses that were revealed to have been too pessimistic a [[11 ABY/Legends|year later]].

In the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] following the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] of [[3996 BBY]], [[Herron Morvis]] was an economist who brought about the ratification of the [[Coruscant Financial Exchange Establishment Act]] as well as served as the [[Director/Legends|director]] of [[Coruscant Financial Exchange]]. Later, the economist [[Argee Beck]] made cautionary comments&mdash;reported on by the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]&mdash;during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] concerning the proliferation of new [[Currency/Legends|currencies]] that was enabled by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], while [[Teubbo]] was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] economist who allied themselves with [[Zsinj's Empire|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] at some point between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. In addition, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Kane Griggs]] wanted to become an economist while enrolled at a [[University/Legends|university]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; however, personal experiences of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] later made him quit his job at the [[Botor Income Ministry]] and sign up as a recruit in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] instead.

==Description==
An economist was a specialist who worked in the field of [[Economics/Legends|economics]].<ref name="HNN" /> In their line of work they could benefit from being able to recognize patterns and trends.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> Economists could be interviewed for their analyses of financial developments such as those concerning currencies,<ref name="HNN" /> and at times they offered their prognoses on how difficult economical situations would progress over [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="GG62">[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters'', Second Edition]]</ref><ref name="JAS">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref> In their work, [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] economists tended to overlook corporations that only operated in a handful of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="RPG2ERE">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> A [[system economist]] was a type of economist.<ref name="GG62" />

==History==
===Under the Republic===
====Reformers and natural experts====
[[File:Cerean_NEGAS.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The physiology of Cereans gave them an advantage toward becoming renowned economists.]]
[[Herron Morvis]] was an economist who brought about the ratification of the [[Coruscant Financial Exchange Establishment Act]] in [[3985 BBY]]. The act allowed [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] corporations to invest in the rebuilding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] infrastructure, including its [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]], in the aftermath of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] of [[3996 BBY]] and helped end a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] of [[Galactic economy|economic]] depression that had followed the war.<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> At some point, Morvis also served as the [[Director/Legends|director]] of [[Coruscant Financial Exchange]].<ref name="KOTORHB">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook]]''</ref>

The [[Cerean/Legends|Cereans]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]], had elongated [[Bone/Legends|craniums]] that housed complex binary [[Brain/Legends|brains]]. Their physiology allowed the Cereans to rapidly process information and notice even convoluted or obscure patterns and trends, and soon after they made first contact with the wider [[galactic community]], they became renowned as expert [[Navigator/Legends|astrogrators]], cryptographers, and economists.<ref name="UAA" />

====Commentary on currency====
{{Quote|'They forget the economic basics that a credit is only worth what someone else will give you for it,' Beck continues.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN" />}}
During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], when [[Star/Legends|star]] systems were seceding from the Republic, the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] announced it had expedited the process of registering a new [[Currency/Legends|currency]] to under thirty [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]]. In response, the economist [[Argee Beck]] commented that the process being so easy presented potential risks to those systems. Beck argued that they would be tempted by the introductory one-to-one exchange rate offered by the Banking Clan as well as the implications of having the name of their own name on money.<ref name="HNN" />

[[File:ToongL-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The economist Argee Beck offered a commentary on the new currency of the Toong'l system.]]
The economist also noted the basic principle of economics that the relative value of any currency was determined by how many units of other currencies one could buy with it. As an example, Beck pointed to the [[King Kikipi credit]] of<ref name="HNN" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Toong'l system/Legends|Toong'l system]], fifteen million units of which could be purchased with just one [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic Credit]]&mdash;with the economist further claiming that the Kikipi reserve consisted simply of a room filled with [[Wocket Festival]] ornaments. Finally, Beck also provided a warning that the Banking Clan's interests ultimately lay with being paid transaction fees for currency conversion services, not the long-term success of the currencies it facilitated the registration of. On the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[22 BBY/Legends|13:3:14]], the economist's comments, juxtaposed with those by the Banking Clan's [[Vice-Chair of Communications]] [[Lo Vapeet]], were included in an issue of the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="HNN" />

===The Empire and beyond===
====Students and prognosticators====
[[File:Daupherm_Planet_States_-_Botor_Enclave.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The would-be economist Kane Griggs hailed from the Botor Enclave and at one point worked at the Botor Income Ministry.]]
[[Kane Griggs]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the planet [[Kerensik]] of the [[Botor Enclave/Legends|Botor Enclave]]<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> who studied at a [[University/Legends|university]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and prior to the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of<ref name="DES" /> the Core Worlds planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="DES" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> He was interested in becoming an economist and wished to obtain a comfortable job in [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]]. Griggs went on to hold a position at the [[Botor Income Ministry]], although after the Empire began to fragment in the wake of its defeat in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="DES" /> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> he quit his job and signed up as a recruit in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] as a direct consequence of the Empire being responsible for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his romantic interest, [[Marfa Thorbin]], at Alderaan. Griggs eventually became a New Republic [[Starship/Legends|starship]] navigator.<ref name="DES" />

Also during the Galactic Civil War, system economists were concerned that the rapid economic collapse on the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Shesharile 5]] and [[Shesharile 6]]<ref name="GG62" /> of the Outer Rim Territories<ref name="EAOC Shesharile">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Shesharile system/Legends|Shesharile system]]</ref> could expand to other worlds. However, that was unlikely due to the natural satellites having had relatively specialized economies.<ref name="GG62" />

====Allies and pessimists====
[[File:ATATCoruscant.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Economists were pessimistic about the recovery of Coruscant from the damage of warfare (pictured) it suffered in 10 ABY.]]
[[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] built up his own [[Zsinj's Empire|Imperial splinter faction]] following the Battle of Endor, and sometime between 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], he recruited not only other [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] but also more unconventional allies. Among the latter was the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] economist [[Teubbo]]. Beginning with the latter [[Standard year/Legends|year]], however, Zsinj's holdings disintegrated.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Core Worlds [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of the New Republic, was [[Second Battle of Coruscant|captured]] by a [[Imperial Coalition|coalition]] of Imperial forces and subsequently became a battleground in the [[Imperial Civil War|civil war]] that ensued between them.<ref name="TEA" /> Economists, disaster consults, and public policy experts all prognosticated that the incalculable damage and high population casualties suffered by the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-world]] would take years, if not decades, to recover from. After the public hysteria subsided, however, the situation appeared to be much less dramatic than previously believed, and, a [[11 ABY/Legends|year later]], the planet had returned to its usual levels of government and business activity, with the recent violence already receding from the collective memory of its inhabitants.<ref name="JAS" /> At some point by [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], economists had also made the claim that waste production on a colossal scale was a sign of a healthy economy.<ref name="FF138">{{FactFile|138|WAS 1-4|Waste Disposal}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Teubbo is a new character; on one level, the image of a Hutt intellectual matches the eccentric image of Zsinj's regime&mdash;but underneath that, the ruthless logic of supply-side economics and the ''kajidic'' patronage network of the Hutts both connect with elements of Zsinj's own approach to power.|Paul R. Urquhart, on the Hutt economist Teubbo|<ref name="Tumblr">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/25851092826/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-13|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 13}}</ref>}}
[[File:Zsinj-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Hutt economist character Teubbo introduced in ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' was intended to connect with characteristics of Imperial Warlord Zsinj (pictured).]]
The occupation of economist was introduced in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise via a mention of system economists in ''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]'', a [[1990]] sourcebook authored by [[Mark Rein-Hagen]] and [[Stewart Wieck]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG1">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> The [[1993]] ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'' by [[Michael Allen Horne]] then identified the general occupation as economist.<ref name="DES" /> In the real world, an [[Wikipedia:Economist|economist]] is a specialist in [[Wikipedia:Economics|economics]],<ref name="Economist">{{WebCite|url=https://www.dictionary.com/browse/economist|text=ECONOMIST Definition & Meaning|work=[[Wikipedia:Dictionary.com|Dictionary.com, LLC]]|archivedate=20230401095429}}</ref> which is a [[Wikipedia:Social science|science]] that studies the general concepts of [[Wikipedia:Production (economics)|production]], [[Wikipedia:Distribution (economics)|distribution]], and [[Wikipedia:Consumption (economics)|consumption]] of [[Wikipedia:Goods and services|goods and services]].<ref name="Economics">{{WebCite|url=https://www.dictionary.com/browse/economics|text=ECONOMICS Definition & Meaning|work=[[Wikipedia:Dictionary.com|Dictionary.com, LLC]]|archivedate=20241204011848}}</ref>

The [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] introduced the character Teubbo, who was a Hutt economist allied with the Imperial Warlord Zsinj.<ref name="EGTW" /> In the endnotes to the book, Urquhart described Teubbo as an "intellectual," noting that the combination of that trait and the character's species was unusual and thereby connecting to Zsinj's eccentric image. Urquhart additionally commented that the economic practices of the Hutt culture also fit with the warlord's ruthlessness.<ref name="Tumblr" />

''[[Enter the Unknown]]'', a [[2013]] sourcebook published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' line of ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' products, provided several suggestions on character backgrounds that players of [[w:c:star-wars-rpg-ffg:Category:Explorer|Explorer]] characters could incorporate into their [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] considerations. One example&mdash;described as "interesting" by the book&mdash;of the Academic background as applied to Explorers with the [[w:c:star-wars-rpg-ffg:Trader|Trader]] specialization was that of a radical economist who had become determined to alter the general operation of [[Merchant/Legends|mercantile]] systems. In the example, the economist had developed theories related to their convictions and was making their way to the Outer Rim Territories in order to test them.<ref name="EtU">''[[Enter the Unknown]]''</ref>
